integrity: All formulas are derived analytically from the normalized fourth dual curvature measure; exact algebraic identities and finite independent radial-angular checks were performed. Computations do not replace the infinite-dimensional support-rigidity argument.
scientific_limitations: Only the fourth dual curvature measure, coordinate-cross atomic support, and equal horizontal masses with unequal vertical masses; not a general non-even uniqueness theorem; historical-priority uncertainty remains.
title: A sharp inverse theorem for non-even fourth dual curvature data on four coordinate normals
